sources.quote: 8.3.3.3 Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: Cutting the tensile test on BR-220 from 1 specimen per heat to 1 per 3 heats changes the sampling frequency of special characteristic SC-01. BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR. Clause 8.3.3.3 therefore requires written Stellantis approval before the change is implemented. No approval is in the documents, and the control plan in force still says 1 specimen per heat.
